messages:
jamie.s: Quick heads-up: we're deprecating long-lived GitHub PATs in CI. Move to OIDC/GitHub Apps + short-lived creds. Goals: remove plaintext secrets from repos, auto-rotation, smaller blast radius. Docs + migration tool by 2026-04-01. Audit-only notifications start 2026-05-15; hard-block 2026-05-30. Post blockers here.

maria: Does this affect self-hosted runners?

jamie.s: Yes. Self-hosted must support OIDC token exchange or use a GitHub App. If you assume cloud roles, switch to OIDC trust. We'll publish a checklist.

sam_k: What about bots using PATs in Vault?

jamie.s: Use GitHub App installations or our Vault adapter that mints short-lived tokens. Migration tool will open PRs to update callers.

diana: Will devs still be able to use personal PATs locally?

jamie.s: Interactive PATs still allowed, but prefer `gh auth login`/short-lived tokens. Policy targets CI/workflow secrets.

devex-bot: Tool: `tools/find_pat_usage.sh` (repo root) - flags workflows and repo secrets. Weekly checker runs; report posted to #eng-security.

maria: Thanks, we'll run the scanner on platform/* tomorrow and share results.

jamie.s: Office hours Tue/Thu 09:00-10:30 PT starting 2026-03-28 in #devex-help. Docs: https://intranet.redwood.ai/docs/github-oidc-migration
